Chemist Chris McCurdy joins Danny Jones to talk about work on the DMT molecule the brain makes on its own. The episode title says a top chemist found how to hack that molecule. McCurdy studies drugs and the brain in a lab.

McCurdy explains what the brain's own DMT may do and how his lab tries to shape it for care. He talks about new compounds that could help mood and the mind without a full trip. Jones asks how close such care sits to real use. Listeners get a lab view of a famed drug. The library holds the talk as an archive record.
